basis: The task requires using the dashboard's labeled rating-share values as the evidence source. The independent visual notes and the O/B checks confirm the printed percentage labels for each category: Quality (36%), Price (38%), Design (34%), Support (45%), Delivery (43%), and Other (53%). Comparing these labeled values, 'Other' has the highest rating share at 53%. The O/B check for record r2 is supported, while record r1 (which relied on visual marker height) is refuted because the task explicitly prioritizes the labeled values over the vertical position of the markers.
